hypothesis: The efficiency of Cas9 DNA cleavage is inversely proportional to the complexity of redesigning the guide RNA sequence
prediction: Cas9 will achieve 80% cleavage efficiency at a target site requiring 3 guide RNA modifications, while TALENs will achieve only 30% efficiency at the same site requiring 3 protein domain modifications
measurement_method: Compare DNA cleavage efficiency at identical target sites using Cas9 with 3 guide RNA modifications versus TALENs with 3 protein domain modifications
falsification_condition: If Cas9 achieves less than 60% cleavage efficiency or TALENs achieve more than 50% efficiency under the same modification conditions
